reasoning: Base ratings: the Bucks are -8.9 and the Lakers +4.7 points per game against an average team; with home court that makes the Lakers 11.6 better here, total 233.
Rest, travel and availability barely move it.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
